description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gampolawela, Ganga Ihala Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320740 (22/0853)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters.
